notes_for_editor: Firelookout.ca gives the tower type, elevation, location and 2026 camera-detection use, but no construction year and no height or access note. The websiteservice.ca towermen list is a hobbyist compilation that asks for corrections; the 1947 rebuild comes from one line in Scotty Percell's entry, and most entries give years only for some people. Several entries read 'Rabbit Hill, Bodmin'; the sources do not say whether Bodmin is a second tower at the same site or a nearby one, so the story does not claim it. Access is left out of facts because no source describes public access. The brief's record (standing, Division No. 18, kind tower, access unknown) matches the sources; no correction proposed. Three web searches were run (one over the budget of two). The firelookout.ca regional index loaded no rows, so it was not used as a source.
